projects.name: Quote-Maker Automation
projects.description: Developed a desktop application for Mikado that auto-generates customer quotes from a parts database, cutting preparation time by ~60 % and eliminating manual calculation errors.

experience.description: Worked on a C# quoting tool that automates customer quotes, reducing preparation time by ~60 % and eliminating manual calculation errors.
Developed various software solutions, including a C# quoting tool for a local business, enhancing productivity and accuracy.
